title.purpose: Run goals, inspector and card heads; user content, never engraved.

label.purpose: Plates, table headers, chips, model aliases.

key-cap.purpose: Buttons, push buttons, nav links, the Live control.

mono.purpose: Counts, ids, effort, diffs; always tabular figures.

shadows.name: ply-1
shadows.purpose: Modules floating over the stage in Immersive; cloud panels.

shadows.name: ply-2
shadows.purpose: Popovers, menus, dialogs, toasts, the stage tooltip.

shadows.name: key-bevel
shadows.purpose: The lower lip of a key cap; the only bevel.

motion.name: relay
motion.purpose: Every chrome state change: colour, border, opacity, scale.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Disclosure chevron rotation, scroll-edge fades, the finding flash.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Drops movement; every lit, pressed and selected state stays.

components.name: Key Cap Button
components.description: The default button: a key cap with a bevelled lip that presses in.
components.css: .ds-key { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; min-height:32px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid var(--rule-2); border-radius:6px; background:var(--key); color:var(--ink); font-family:"D-DIN Condensed", "Arial Narrow", "Roboto Condensed", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:.929rem; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 light-dark(rgb(0 0 0 / .08), rgb(0 0 0 / .35)); transition:background-color 80ms linear, border-color 80ms linear, scale 80ms linear; } .ds-key:hover { background:var(--key-hover); border-color:var(--ink-2); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--route); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-key:active { scale:.96; }

components.name: Primary Key
components.description: The one committing action in a dialog: a route-coloured face.
components.css: .ds-key-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:32px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid var(--route); border-radius:6px; background:var(--route); color:var(--desk); font-family:"D-DIN Condensed", "Arial Narrow", "Roboto Condensed", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:.929rem; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; transition:opacity 80ms linear, scale 80ms linear; } .ds-key-primary:hover { opacity:.9; } .ds-key-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--route); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-key-primary:active { scale:.96; }

components.name: Push-button Bank
components.description: A bank of push buttons; the pressed one lights its route lamp. Also the desk nav.
components.css: .ds-seg { display:inline-flex; border:1px solid var(--rule-2); border-radius:6px; background:var(--module-2); padding:2px; } .ds-seg button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; min-height:28px; padding:0 10px 0 9px; border:0; border-radius:4px; background:none; color:var(--ink-2); font-family:"D-DIN Condensed", "Arial Narrow", "Roboto Condensed", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:.929rem; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 80ms linear; } .ds-seg button::before { content:""; width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--lamp-off); transition:background-color 80ms linear; } .ds-seg button:hover { background:var(--key); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--route); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed=true] { background:var(--key); color:var(--ink); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule-2); } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed=true]::before { background:var(--route); }

components.name: Engraved Plate
components.description: Every region heading: condensed DIN capitals on the plate ground.
components.css: .ds-plate { display:inline-block; margin:0; padding:2px 7px 1px; border-radius:3px; background:var(--plate); color:var(--plate-ink); font-family:"D-DIN Condensed", "Arial Narrow", "Roboto Condensed", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:.857rem; line-height:1.25; letter-spacing:.07em; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.name: Status Chips
components.description: A lamp and its legend; hollow lamps mark a family's non-plain case, running blinks at 1Hz.
components.html: Merged 5Running 2Pending 1Fail 1Accepted
components.css: .ds-chips { display:inline-flex; gap:4px; flex-wrap:wrap; } .ds-chip { --st:var(--lamp-off); --st-fill:var(--st); --st-ring:var(--lamp-edge, rgb(0 0 0 / .2)); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; padding:1px 7px 0 6px; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:4px; background:var(--key); color:var(--ink); font-family:"D-DIN Condensed", "Arial Narrow", "Roboto Condensed", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:.857rem; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; line-height:1.5; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-chip::before { content:""; width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--st-fill); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--st-ring); } .ds-ok { --st:var(--lamp-green); } .ds-run { --st:var(--lamp-amber); } .ds-bad { --st:var(--lamp-red); } .ds-hollow { --st-fill:transparent; --st-ring:var(--st); } .ds-run::before { animation:ds-blink 1s steps(1, end) infinite; } @keyframes ds-blink { 50% { opacity:.35; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-run::before { animation:none; } }

components.name: Describer Window
components.description: Run counts and times on black glass, tabular mono.
components.css: .ds-describer { display:inline-flex; align-items:baseline; gap:12px; padding:3px 9px; border-radius:6px; background:var(--glass); color:var(--glass-ink); font-family:ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size:.786rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; white-space:nowrap; color-scheme:dark; } .ds-describer .ds-dim { color:var(--glass-dim); }

components.name: Model Name Plate
components.description: The one way a model is shown: alias engraved, effort in mono.
components.css: .ds-mp { display:inline-flex; align-items:stretch; border:1px solid var(--rule-2); border-radius:4px; overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap; line-height:1.55; } .ds-mp-name { padding:0 6px; background:var(--module-2); color:var(--ink); font-family:"D-DIN Condensed", "Arial Narrow", "Roboto Condensed", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:.857rem; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; transition:background-color 80ms linear; } .ds-mp:hover .ds-mp-name { background:var(--key-hover); } .ds-mp-effort { display:flex; align-items:center; padding:0 6px; border-left:1px solid var(--rule); color:var(--muted); font-family:ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace; font-size:.786rem; }

components.css: .ds-sevs { display:inline-flex; gap:12px; } .ds-sev { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-family:ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace; font-size:.786rem; color:var(--ink); } .ds-sev::before { content:""; width:9px; height:9px; background:var(--sev); clip-path:var(--shape); } .ds-p0 { --sev:var(--sev-p0); --shape:polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-p1 { --sev:var(--sev-p1); --shape:polygon(50% 0, 100% 50%, 50% 100%, 0 50%); } .ds-p2 { --sev:var(--sev-p2); --shape:polygon(0 8%, 100% 8%, 50% 100%); } .ds-p3 { --sev:var(--sev-p3); --shape:circle(45%); }

narrative.overview:
forge-ui is a relay interlocking route-setting desk, after the Italian ACEI panels, built for code. A run is an inlaid track diagram (the 3D plate) set into an enamelled grey-green desk. Tasks are track sections, and their lamps show clear, occupied or failed before anyone reads a word. Everything around the plate is desk furniture. Region headings are engraved plates, toggles are push buttons with their own lamp, and numbers sit in black-glass describer windows. The desk is dense and quiet. The only saturated colour on it comes from lamps, and each lamp means one thing.

Both themes are finished to the same standard. Every colour token is a `light-dark()` pair: pale enamel with black plates in light, near-black green enamel with bone plates in dark. The system setting chooses the theme, and `<html data-theme>` overrides it. The 3D plate reads its colours from these same tokens through a probe element, so the desk and the diagram never drift apart. Depth comes in three plies (panel, module, popover) and nothing in between. Motion is relay motion: chrome changes state in 80ms with no easing, and running lamps blink at 1Hz.

The world rejects the dark dashboard of cards, sidebars and one blue accent, and it rejects skeuomorphic hardware. There are no screws, levers, rails or brushed metal. The desk is suggested by its typography, its lamps and its plies, not by drawn hardware.
keyCharacteristics: Enamelled grey-green desk in both themes, with three plies of depth only.
Engraved plates in condensed DIN capitals on every region heading.
Push-button banks whose lamp lights when a button is pressed in.
Black-glass describer windows for counts, ids and times, set in tabular mono digits.
Five lamps with one meaning each. A hollow ring marks the family's non-plain case.
Review severity shown as shape on its own colour ramp, never as a status lamp.
One name plate per model everywhere it appears.
Relay motion: 80ms linear, a 1Hz blink, and every state kept under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Lamp, One Meaning Rule
rules.body: There are five lamps: green for clear (merged or passed), amber for occupied (running), red for failed, unlit for pending, and route white for a set route or selection. Never use a lamp colour for decoration or for a second meaning.

rules.name: The Hollow Lamp Rule
rules.body: A lamp drawn as a ring with a transparent fill belongs to its family but is not the plain case. Accepted and no changes are hollow green, interrupted is hollow amber, and infra, timeout and blocked are hollow red.

rules.name: The Separate Ramp Rule
rules.body: Review severity has its own colour ramp and always comes with a shape. It never borrows a status lamp.

rules.name: The Single Source Rule
rules.body: Every colour the 3D plate draws (`--stage-*`, `--st`, `--st-lit`) is a token in style.css and is read through the stage probe. Do not hard-code colours in the 3D code.

rules.name: The Engraving Rule
rules.body: Every region heading is an engraved plate: D-DIN capitals on the plate ground at 3px radius. Do not set a region heading as plain bold sans.

rules.name: The Describer Rule
rules.body: Numbers that describe a run (counts, wall time, ids) go in tabular mono, and on a describer window when they sit in a header.

rules.name: The Three Plies Rule
rules.body: Use the panel, a module or a popover, and nothing else. A box inside a module is a tonal well with a hairline, not a raised card.

dos: Do take every colour from a `light-dark()` token on `:root`, so both themes stay equally finished and the 3D plate can read it through the probe.
Do put every region heading on an engraved plate (D-DIN 700, 0.857rem, 0.07em, uppercase, plate ground, 3px radius).
Do make every toggle a push button in a bank whose lamp lights when it is pressed (`aria-pressed` or `aria-current`).
Do use exactly one lamp meaning per state, and use the hollow ring for a family's non-plain case.
Do show review severity as shape plus the severity ramp (P0 spike, P1 diamond, P2 cone, P3 pin).
Do show every model through the name plate (alias engraved, effort in mono).
Do use relay timing (80ms linear) for chrome state changes, and keep every state when motion is reduced.
Do draw new icons in the authored set: 24-unit grid, 1.5 stroke, round joins, currentColor.
donts: Don't add a fourth ply. A box inside a module is a tonal well with a hairline, not a shadowed card.
Don't use a lamp colour as decoration or as a brand accent. Amber means occupied, and its non-state uses are limited to the stage accent, the caret, selection and the measured band.
Don't colour review severity with a status lamp.
Don't draw hardware: no fake screws, levers, rails or brushed metal.
Don't use inline styles or `innerHTML`. The page CSP refuses them.
Don't use emoji or text glyphs as icons.
